title: Spätzle Noodle Stir Fry
description: A German-inspired stir fry made with Spätzle noodles and midnight sauce, served with a side of sautéed vegetables.

ingredients.name: Cooked sausage (optional)
ingredients.notes: German-style sausage such as Bratwurst or Weisswurst

instructions: Cook Spätzle noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chopped vegetables and cook until tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cooked sausage (if using) and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add Midnight sauce, soy sauce, and sugar to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Add cooked Spätzle noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stir fry to a serving dish and garnish with chopped scallions.
